{{Quote|We suspects remnants of an asteroid mining operation in the Udine system revolted and formed a pirate band. As they were aware of the hyperlane shortcut through nearby Keller's Void, they began towing immense asteroids to block ships and force them out of hyperspace.|Blissa Vlix|<ref name="QS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030828web|text=Quick Starfields}}</ref>}}
'''Blissa Vlix''' was an individual who served as the head of the [[Trade and Traffic Ministry]], an organization that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. After a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group attacked a number of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] along [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked Wroona and the planet [[Calus]], Vlix announced that the Trade and Traffic Ministry suspected that the pirates were former [[Mining/Legends|miners]] from the [[Udine system/Legends|Udine system]].
